zh-CN.title: 道安组织译经与僧团网络
zh-CN.shortSummary: 约 365–385 年，道安在襄阳及长安语境中组织译经、讲学与僧团规范，形成佛教知识传播的制度节点。
curatorialDescription: 事件把人物、译场和城市分开建模；襄阳与长安是两个空间锚点，不是一条未经核实的逐站路线。
zh-CN.researchNote: 译场参与者、具体译本和道安迁徙顺序需要传记与目录级来源继续拆分。

en.title: Dao'an organises a translation and monastic network
en.shortSummary: Around 365–385, Dao'an's translation, teaching and monastic organisation in the Xiangyang and Chang'an contexts formed an institutional node in Buddhist transmission.
curatorialDescription: The event keeps figure, translation setting and city distinct; Xiangyang and Chang'an are two spatial anchors, not an unverified stop-by-stop route.
en.researchNote: Translation personnel, individual works and the sequence of Dao'an's movements require further biographical and catalogue-level separation.

zh-CN.title: 慧远与庐山东林寺僧团
zh-CN.shortSummary: 约 386 年，慧远在庐山组织东林寺僧团，使山地成为佛教制度、修行和跨区域交流的空间。
curatorialDescription: 东林寺的创建是地点、人物与僧团制度的交汇事件；后世净土叙事另作为接受层处理。
zh-CN.researchNote: 寺院初期组织、参与者与书信网络需继续按传记和遗产资料细化。

en.title: Huiyuan and the Donglin community at Mount Lu
en.shortSummary: Around 386, Huiyuan organised the Donglin community at Mount Lu, making the mountain a setting for Buddhist institutions, practice and transregional exchange.
curatorialDescription: Donglin's foundation is an event at the intersection of place, figure and monastic organisation; later Pure Land narratives remain a reception layer.
en.researchNote: The early community, participants and correspondence network require further biographical and heritage-level detail.

zh-CN.title: 陶弘景隐居茅山与梁廷咨询
zh-CN.shortSummary: 约 500–536 年，陶弘景以茅山为活动空间，并与梁武帝保持书信和知识咨询往来。
curatorialDescription: 事件不把陶弘景写成持续驻守建康的宫廷官员；茅山和建康分别承担隐居与制度联系两种空间角色。
zh-CN.researchNote: 书信时间、咨询主题和茅山宫观沿革需要继续按文本与地方资料核对。

en.title: Tao Hongjing at Mount Mao and in consultation with the Liang court
en.shortSummary: Around 500–536, Tao Hongjing worked from the Mount Mao setting while maintaining correspondence and knowledge consultation with Liang Wudi.
curatorialDescription: The event does not turn Tao Hongjing into a continuously resident court official in Jiankang; Mount Mao and Jiankang carry reclusion and institutional-connection roles respectively.
en.researchNote: Letter dates, consultation topics and the history of Mount Mao monasteries require further textual and local-gazetteer review.

zh-CN.title: 梁武帝的佛教制度与宫廷赞助
zh-CN.shortSummary: 502–549 年，梁武帝的宫廷政策把建康、寺院制度、仪式与佛教赞助放在同一国家空间。
curatorialDescription: 事件呈现制度和赞助层，不把‘菩萨皇帝’的后世称号直接等同于单一政策或个人信仰。
zh-CN.researchNote: 寺院数量、度僧制度、宫廷仪式和三教互动需继续按正史与制度史材料拆分。

en.title: Liang Wudi's Buddhist institutions and court patronage
en.shortSummary: From 502–549, Liang Wudi's court policy placed Jiankang, monastery institutions, ritual and Buddhist patronage within one state space.
curatorialDescription: The event presents institutions and patronage without equating the later ‘Bodhisattva Emperor’ title with one policy or undifferentiated personal belief.
en.researchNote: Monastery numbers, ordination policy, court ritual and Three Teachings interaction require further separation in histories and institutional sources.

zh-CN.title: 一行与大衍历编纂
zh-CN.shortSummary: 约 721–725 年，一行参与大衍历相关的天文计算与历法工程，把僧侣知识与长安国家制度连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 事件把历法工程、天文计算和人物身份分层；长安是制度锚点，不代表所有观测都发生在同一处。
zh-CN.researchNote: 历法版本、观测设备、参与者与颁行过程需继续按历志和唐代史料核对。

en.title: Yixing and the Dayan calendar
en.shortSummary: Around 721–725, Yixing contributed to astronomical calculation and calendrical work associated with the Dayan calendar, connecting monastic knowledge with Chang'an institutions.
curatorialDescription: The event separates calendrical work, astronomical calculation and figure identity; Chang'an is an institutional anchor and not the location of every observation.
en.researchNote: Calendar versions, instruments, participants and promulgation require further checking against calendrical treatises and Tang records.

zh-CN.title: 朱熹复兴白鹿洞书院
zh-CN.shortSummary: 约 1179–1191 年，朱熹在庐山推动白鹿洞书院复兴，使山地文化景观成为儒学教育与经典解释空间。
curatorialDescription: 书院复兴是教育制度、地点和人物活动的交汇事件；它与慧远的东晋僧团相隔数百年。
zh-CN.researchNote: 书院章程、讲学文本和地方空间需要继续绑定文集、碑刻与遗产资料。

en.title: Zhu Xi revives the White Deer Grotto Academy
en.shortSummary: Around 1179–1191, Zhu Xi promoted the revival of the White Deer Grotto Academy at Mount Lu, turning the landscape into a setting for Confucian education and classical interpretation.
curatorialDescription: The academy revival is an event at the intersection of educational institution, place and figure activity; it is separated from Huiyuan's Eastern Jin monastic community by centuries.
en.researchNote: Academy regulations, teaching texts and the local site require continued linking to collected writings, inscriptions and heritage records.
